pooltable.tooltip.lamp: Right-click a pool table to hang it over the middle
pooltable.tooltip.lamp.hang: Hangs from the ceiling above it, up to 24 blocks up
pooltable.tooltip.lamp.float: Floats over the table: no ceiling needed
pooltable.msg.lamp_no_room: Needs a ceiling at least 3 blocks high above the table
pooltable.tooltip.table: 3 x 5 blocks. Places away from you from where you click.
pooltable.tooltip.cue.1: On your go, right-click near a table to step up to the ball.
pooltable.tooltip.cue.2: Hold right-click to draw back, let go to shoot. Scroll for spin.
pooltable.tooltip.cue.3: Left-click steps back, or cancels a draw.
pooltable.tooltip.rack.use: Right-click with a cue to rack it; with an empty hand to take one.
pooltable.msg.no_room: Not enough room: a pool table needs 3 x 5 clear blocks in front of you.
pooltable.msg.join: %s took a seat. Waiting for an opponent.
pooltable.msg.bot_level: The bot is playing on %s now.
pooltable.msg.foul.scratch: Foul: %s scratched. %s has ball in hand.
pooltable.msg.foul.no_contact: Foul: %s missed everything. %s has ball in hand.
pooltable.msg.foul.wrong_ball: Foul: %s hit the wrong ball first. %s has ball in hand.
pooltable.msg.foul.wrong_ball.plain: Foul: %s hit the wrong ball first. %s to shoot.
pooltable.msg.not_banked: %s's ball went in without a bank - it doesn't count. %s to shoot.
pooltable.msg.rebreak: The black went down on the break - re-rack, and %s breaks again.
pooltable.msg.ball_respot: The %s goes back on the spot.
pooltable.msg.game_ready: Now playing %s - New rack to start.
pooltable.msg.format_ready: Match format set to %s - New rack to start.
pooltable.msg.eight_respot: The 8 went down on the break - it's back on the spot.
pooltable.msg.lose_call: %s potted the 8 in the wrong pocket - %s wins! (%s)
pooltable.msg.practice_scratch: Scratch! The cue ball is back behind the line.
pooltable.msg.practice_cleared: Table cleared! Right-click the table to rack again.
pooltable.hud.practice_game: Practice (%s) - anyone with a cue can shoot
pooltable.hud.hint.call: Calling the ringed pocket  |  Middle-click: call another
pooltable.hud.hint.step_up: Your shot - right-click with the cue to step up
pooltable.hud.hint.step_up_in_hand: Your shot, ball in hand - right-click with the cue to pick up the cue ball
pooltable.hud.hint.step_up_practice: Right-click with the cue to step up  |  Sneak + right-click: move the cue ball
pooltable.hud.hint.aim: Hold right-click to shoot  |  Left-click: step back  |  Sneak: fine  |  Scroll: spin
pooltable.hud.hint.aim_vr: Point your controller to aim  |  Hold use to shoot  |  Attack: step back  |  Sneak: fine
pooltable.hud.hint.in_hand: Look where you want the cue ball, right-click to put it down  |  Left-click: step back
pooltable.hud.hint.camera: Mouse: aim and tilt  |  Hold right-click to shoot  |  Left-click: step back  |  Sneak: fine
pooltable.hud.hint.in_hand_kitchen: Look where you want the cue ball (behind the line), right-click to put it down
pooltable.hud.hint.watch: Mouse: look around  |  Scroll: zoom  |  Left-click: back to your view
pooltable.hud.hint.over: Game over - right-click the table for a new rack
